title: Quinto dia útil 2026 e 2027: a data do pagamento em cada mês
description: O quinto dia útil de novembro de 2026 é sábado, 7; o de dezembro, sábado, 5. Veja todos os meses até dezembro de 2027 e como contar: o sábado entra.

faq.q: O sábado conta como dia útil para o pagamento do salário?
faq.a: Conta. Pela Instrução Normativa MTP n.º 2/2021 (art. 14, I), na contagem dos dias entra o sábado e ficam de fora o domingo e o feriado, inclusive o municipal.

faq.q: E se o quinto dia útil cair no sábado?
faq.a: O prazo termina nesse sábado. Quando o pagamento é feito pelo banco, o valor precisa estar à disposição do empregado até o quinto dia útil (art. 14, II, da mesma instrução normativa).

faq.q: Feriado municipal ou estadual muda o quinto dia útil?
faq.a: Muda. O feriado local não entra na contagem, então, se ele cair nos primeiros dias do mês, o quinto dia útil passa para o dia útil seguinte na sua cidade. A tabela desta página considera só os feriados nacionais.

faq.q: De onde vem a regra do quinto dia útil?
faq.a: Do art. 459, § 1º, da CLT: quando o pagamento é mensal, ele deve ser feito, o mais tardar, até o quinto dia útil do mês seguinte ao trabalhado.

faq.q: Como coloco o dia do pagamento na tela de bloqueio do iPhone?
faq.a: Crie no Countdown: Contagem regressiva um evento com a data do quinto dia útil deste mês e, na Tela Bloqueada, toque e segure → Personalizar → Tela Bloqueada → Adicionar widgets → Countdown. Como a data muda de mês para mês, atualize o evento no mês seguinte; se a sua empresa paga sempre no mesmo dia, use a repetição mensal. Os widgets são grátis em todos os tamanhos.

faq.q: ¿Qué debe llevar una cotización?
faq.a: La palabra Cotización y un folio, la fecha y la vigencia, tus datos de contacto, los datos del cliente, cada concepto con cantidad, precio unitario e importe, el subtotal, el IVA con su tasa y el total, y las condiciones: forma de pago, tiempo de entrega y anticipo si lo pides.

description: 免費報價單範本：線上填好公司、客戶與品項，金額、稅額與總計自動計算，再列印或存成 PDF。不用註冊，港台都適用。

faq.q: 這個報價單範本免費嗎？
faq.a: 是。整份在你的瀏覽器裡填寫，不會上傳，不用帳號，也沒有浮水印。填好後列印或存成 PDF。

faq.q: 報價單要寫哪些內容？
faq.a: 「報價單」字樣與編號、日期與有效期限、你的公司名稱與聯絡方式（台灣可加上統一編號）、客戶資料、每個項目的數量、單價與金額、小計、稅額與總計，以及付款條件和交期。

faq.q: 報價單的有效期限怎麼寫？
faq.a: 就是你保證這個價格到哪一天。範本預設為今天起 15 天，可以直接改。

faq.q: 報價單要含稅嗎？
faq.a: 在台灣，營業稅的一般稅率是 5%，報價時寫清楚含稅或未稅，之後比較不會有爭議；把稅率欄改成 5，稅額就會自動算出來。香港沒有營業稅，稅率欄保持 0。

faq.q: 有 Excel 或 Word 版本嗎？
faq.a: 沒有。這個範本直接在網頁上填，完成後存成 PDF 寄給客戶，排版不會跑掉；如果要重複使用客戶與項目，可以用我們的 iPhone App。

faq.q: 怎麼存成 PDF？
faq.a: 按「列印／存成 PDF」（香港叫打印），在列印視窗把目的地選成「另存為 PDF」。只會印出報價單本身，頁面其他內容會自動隱藏。

faq.q: 有 App 可以在 iPhone 上開報價單嗎？
faq.a: 「開單、報價單、收據、送貨單產生器」是我們的 iPhone App，做的就是這件事，還會記住客戶與項目：先寄報價單，客戶確認後一鍵轉成帳單；每份帳單都可以附上收款 QR Code，簽名直接在 iPhone 上手寫；收款結清後，同一份帳單可以直接當作收據分享。第一份免費，免註冊帳號。

description: 免費收據範本：線上填寫「茲收到」格式的收據，輸入金額就自動寫出中文大寫，再列印或存成 PDF。不用註冊，港台都適用。

faq.q: 這個收據範本免費嗎？
faq.a: 是。整份在你的瀏覽器裡填寫，不會上傳，不用帳號，也沒有浮水印。填好後列印或存成 PDF。

faq.q: 收據金額為什麼要寫大寫？
faq.a: 大寫數字筆畫多、不容易被塗改，例如「壹萬貳仟參佰元整」；最後的「整」表示沒有零頭。在範本裡輸入數字，大寫會自動寫出來。

faq.q: 「茲收到」是什麼意思？
faq.a: 「茲」是「此、現在」的意思，「茲收到」就是「現在確實收到」。這是收據開頭的固定用語，表示收款人確認已經收到這筆錢。

faq.q: 「茲收到」後面要寫什麼？
faq.a: 寫付款人的姓名或公司名稱，接著寫「繳付」與款項的事由，例如「茲收到 王小明 繳付 十月份房租 款項」。

faq.q: 金額有小數怎麼辦？
faq.a: 範本的大寫以整數元計算，小數會捨去；金額有角或分的話，請在大寫欄自己補上。

faq.q: 收據可以當發票用嗎？
faq.a: 不行。收據證明你收到了款項；在台灣，營業人依法要開的是統一發票。在香港，「發票」通常指請款用的單據（invoice），不是稅務憑證。這個範本和我們的 App 都不開立稅務發票。

faq.q: 有 App 可以在 iPhone 上開收據嗎？
faq.a: 有。在我們的「開單、報價單、收據、送貨單產生器」裡，收款結清後，同一份帳單可以直接當作收據分享：標記為已付，並附上結清日期。帳單可以附收款 QR Code，也能在 iPhone 上手寫簽名。第一份免費，免註冊帳號。

description: How to write an invoice that gets paid: what to include, how to number it, payment terms that work, and the mistakes that delay payment. With a free template.

faq.q: What should I put on an invoice?
faq.a: The word Invoice, a unique number, issue and due dates, your business details, the client's details, each item with quantity and price, subtotal, tax and total, and how to pay. Add your tax ID if your country requires it.

faq.q: How do I number invoices?
faq.a: Sequentially and never reused: INV-0001, INV-0002… Many freelancers prefix the year (2026-001) so the sequence resets each January. Never reuse a number, and check local rules: some countries, such as France and Germany, expect an unbroken sequence.

faq.q: What payment terms should a freelancer use?
faq.a: Net 14 or Net 30 are the most common — payment due 14 or 30 days after the invoice date. For new clients or small jobs, 'due on receipt' is normal. State the terms and the due date on the invoice itself.

faq.q: Can I charge a late fee?
faq.a: Usually yes if the terms were agreed before the work — put them on the estimate or contract and repeat them on the invoice. Check local rules; some countries cap late interest.

faq.q: What's the difference between an invoice and a receipt?
faq.a: An invoice asks for payment and has a due date. A receipt confirms that payment was made. Once an invoice is paid, the same document marked Paid with the paid date can serve as the receipt.

faq.q: Is an estimate the same thing as a quote?
faq.a: In everyday use, yes. Both describe a proposed price sent before the work starts, and neither is a request for payment.

faq.q: Is an invoice automatically a legal tax document?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Some countries require a specific tax invoice format, such as Mexico's CFDI, and Invoice Maker creates commercial documents rather than government tax invoices, so check local rules if you need one.

faq.q: How do I turn an estimate into an invoice?
faq.a: In Invoice Maker, open the estimate or quote and turn it into an invoice with one tap, without re-entering the client or line items.

faq.q: How many documents can I create for free?
faq.a: One in total. Your first document is free, whether it's an invoice, an estimate or a quote — there isn't a separate allowance for each type, and it doesn't reset monthly. Editing it or sending it again later is free.

title: Turn TikTok and Instagram Travel Posts into an Itinerary
description: Turn the travel posts you saved on TikTok and Instagram into a day-by-day itinerary, by hand or from screenshots, and check what a post won't tell you.

faq.q: How do I turn a TikTok travel video into an itinerary?
faq.a: Write down every place the video names — from the caption, the pinned comment and the text on screen — pin them on a map, group nearby places into days, and put anything booked for a set time on its own day. In BeforeGo you can screenshot the caption instead, and it files the places into a day-by-day plan.

faq.q: Can I make an itinerary from my Instagram saved posts?
faq.a: Yes. Put the posts for one trip into their own Saved collection, then screenshot each one into BeforeGo, or list the places by hand and group them by neighborhood into days.

faq.q: How do I add a travel post I saw on social media to my trip?
faq.a: Screenshot the post, caption included, and BeforeGo files the places into a day-by-day plan. For a guide or article on the web, paste its link, or type the plans out yourself.

faq.q: Can I import an already-booked flight or hotel?
faq.a: Yes. Scan the ticket or booking confirmation and BeforeGo places it on your route in order, including its days.

faq.q: Can I remove something BeforeGo imported that I don't want?
faq.a: Yes. Every import is listed under its trip, and any line it added can be removed.

faq.q: Does BeforeGo replace checking official travel requirements?
faq.a: No. BeforeGo is for personal travel organization, not official visa, safety, health, airline, or government guidance, so always confirm important requirements with official sources.

title: A Packing List That Fits the Destination: Plugs, Currency, Rules
description: What to check per destination before you pack, and how a generated packing list covers plugs, currency, entry rules and reminders.

faq.q: What should a packing list account for beyond clothes?
faq.a: It generally helps to check the plug type and voltage, the local currency, entry requirements like visas, and which transit apps are used locally.

faq.q: Does BeforeGo build the packing list automatically?
faq.a: Yes. BeforeGo generates a destination-based packing list, including plugs, currency, entry rules and transit apps, from your trip's destination and dates.

faq.q: When do packing reminders arrive?
faq.a: BeforeGo sends packing reminders at 7 days, 3 days, 24 hours and 3 hours before departure.

faq.q: What happens to items I forgot to pack last time?
faq.a: Forgotten items carry over, so your next packing list starts smarter.
